hits.title: AArete Names Healthcare Leader Pam Shipley as CEO - AArete
hits.snippet: CHICAGO–(BUSINESS WIRE)–AArete, a leading global management and technology consulting firm, announced today the appointment of Pam Shipley as chief executive officer. A Fortune 25 healthcare executive with more than 30 years of experience, Shipley succeeds AArete Founder Loren Trimble, who will transition from his role as CEO to board member. Shipley joins AArete from Centene Corporation, a leading managed care organization, in which she most recently served as chief strategy officer. She spent nearly 14 years at Centene over two tenures where she held multiple CEO roles in Georgia, Missouri and Mississippi and led digital transformation and market expansion across more than 15 markets. [...] “What we’ve built at AArete would not be possible without a culture built on integrity, excellence and care for the people we serve, and I’m proud that Pam will continue that legacy,” Trimble said. “She’s a purpose-driven leader whose passion for people and delivering results for clients reflects the values of the firm. I am confident she will lead AArete into its next chapter and build on its success.” [...] Skip to content AArete

hits.title: Loren Trimble - CEO & Managing Director - AArete
hits.snippet: # Loren Trimble – CEO & Managing Director Loren Trimble is the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of AArete LLC with a primary focus on creating and molding AArete’s business solutions, while also helping clients achieve short-term and long-term goals related to profit improvement. Before founding AArete, Loren was a Managing Director and Strategic Sourcing Practice Lead at Huron Consulting. Prior to Huron, he started the Strategic Sourcing services for Arthur Andersen, developing the methodology and refining the approach through numerous client engagements. [...] As CEO, Loren brings extensive business and operations strategy experience, serving clients in the pharmaceutical, distribution, consumer products, and business services industries globally. Specific areas of expertise include strategic profitability improvement, revenue cycle improvements, strategic sourcing, procurement transformation, and pre-and post-merger value generation.
